launch_authority: Parent reviews and launches; preparation made no GPU calls.
dependency_note: Launch only after the actual startup queue has completed, using its verified --after-status path. This planned path is documentation, not an active dependency. Per-job depends_on is documentary; runner executes serially. Missing upstream files fail rather than trigger fallback training.
execution_order: For each alpha: gate0 then gate2000; each train followed by chronological evals and fixed expert CPU probes. All jobs serial, never six concurrent GPU jobs.

scientific_contrast.interpretation: Adaptive initial-alpha intervention affecting BOTH actor maximum-entropy objective and critic soft TD targets. Native alpha updates remain active after the gate. NOT a pure actor entropy-term test and NOT proof a smaller alpha solves training.

baseline_reuse.meaning: Identical initial actors across all clones, so frozen update0 actor baseline reused. Full update0 checkpoint snapshots still saved; alpha does not scale this rollout sampling std.
baseline_reuse.alpha_001_rerun: Baseline alpha .01 rerun at the exact same short budget; prior longer retention runs are context, not the paired endpoint.

jobs.dataset_context: Fixed official successful expert states, not training replay or true-Q calibration. Update2000 is warmup end only for gate2000, and a matched reference for gate0.
